# Third-party code

Only what the firmware needs is vendored; versions are pinned. Nothing here is modified, except one
fix in TinyUSB (below).

| Directory | What | Version / source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cmsis_core/Include/` | ARM CMSIS-Core headers for Cortex-M7 (`core_cm7.h`, `cmsis_gcc.h`, `cmsis_compiler.h`, `cmsis_version.h`, `mpu_armv7.h`, `cachel1_armv7.h`) | CMSIS_5 tag **5.9.0**, https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5 (`CMSIS/Core/Include`) | Apache-2.0 (`cmsis_core/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `cmsis_device_h7/Include/` | ST device headers (`stm32h743xx.h`, `stm32h7xx.h`, `system_stm32h7xx.h`) — register definitions only; no ST HAL/LL is used | cmsis-device-h7 tag **v1.10.7**, https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/cmsis-device-h7 | Apache-2.0 (`cmsis_device_h7/LICENSE.md`) |
| `fonts/` | X11 misc-fixed Unicode BDF fonts `10x20`, `7x14`, `6x13` (`6x10` kept as a spare) | Markus Kuhn's ucs-fonts, https://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/~mgk25/download/ucs-fonts.tar.gz (2009-04-06 release) | Public domain ("Public domain font. Share and enjoy." in each BDF; see `fonts/README.ucs-fonts`) |
| `tinyusb/` | TinyUSB USB device stack, only what the calculator's device needs: `src/tusb.c`, `src/common/`, `src/osal/osal.h` + `osal_none.h`, `src/device/`, the device side of `src/class/cdc/` and `src/class/msc/`, `src/portable/synopsys/dwc2/` (`dcd_dwc2.c`, `dwc2_common.c/h`, `dwc2_stm32.h`, `dwc2_type.h`). Configured by `platform/stm32h743/tusb_config.h`; firmware only (the simulators model the device). One change, marked "calculator patch" in `dcd_dwc2.c` `handle_rxflvl_irq`: a zero-length OUT packet counts as a short packet (the release completed such a transfer with its full requested length, so the CDC console received the previous packet's bytes again; re-check on an update). The USB diagnostics count the driver's events by wrapping `dcd_event_handler` at the link | tag **0.18.0**, https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb | MIT (`tinyusb/LICENSE`) |
| `micropython/` | MicroPython, the Python interpreter of the Python module (`modules/python`, docs/QSPI_CONTENT.md 12.8): `py/` (the core: every `.c`/`.h` and the header generators `make*.py`, without the native-code emitters and assemblers `asm*.c`, `emitn*.c`, `emitinline*.c` and the NLR files of other CPUs; `asmbase.h` and `asmrv32.h` stay because `compile.c` and `modsys.c` include them), `extmod/` `modheapq.c`, `modjson.c`, `modrandom.c`, `modre.c`, `modtime.c/.h`, `misc.h`, `modplatform.h`, `lib/re1.5/` (the regular expression engine `modre.c` includes), `shared/runtime/gchelper.h` + `gchelper_generic.c`. Configured by `modules/python/mpconfigport.h`; the generated headers (qstrs, module and root-pointer tables) are made by `tools/py_genhdr.py` with the upstream scripts. **No upstream file is modified**: the module is a code-load module (copied to SDRAM and relocated), so MicroPython keeps its static data as it is; `open()` and the HAL are the port's (`modules/python/py_entry.c`) | tag **v1.29.0** (commit 0fd6c57), https://github.com/micropython/micropython | MIT (`micropython/LICENSE`; `lib/re1.5`: BSD-style, listed there) |
| `katex/` | KaTeX, the math typesetter of the browser notebook (`web/notebook`, inlined by `web/notebook/build.py`): `katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css` and 11 of its fonts as woff2 (`AMS-Regular`, `Caligraphic-Regular`, `Main-Bold`, `Main-Italic`, `Main-Regular`, `Math-Italic`, `Size1`-`Size4-Regular`, `Typewriter-Regular`; the others are left out of the page) | npm package `katex` **0.16.22** (`dist/`), https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX | MIT (`katex/LICENSE`) |
| `newhaven_nhd28/` | Newhaven's official ST7789VI example for the NHD-2.8-240320AF-CSXP-F (source of the factory-tuned init values used in `platform/stm32h743/lcd.c`) | https://github.com/newhavendisplay/NHD-2.8-240320AF-CSXP-F_Example commit **f2e2d81** (2021-01-12), see `SOURCE.txt` | BSD-3-Clause (`newhaven_nhd28/LICENSE`) |

Generated from these: `core/gen/fonts_gen.c` (`tools/gen_font.py`, glyph subset only).

To update: download the new tag, copy the same files over, rebuild, and update this table (and
re-apply or drop the TinyUSB patch above).
